description:
Antique gold chain necklace passed down from the client’s great-grandmother, featuring substantial textured interlocking links and intriguing Imperial Russian style hallmarks. The chain itself was tested using a Thermo Fisher XRF metal analyzer and produced a reading of 18.15K gold.
The clasp assembly bears a “56” mark with a female profile resembling the Russian kokoshnik assay mark used during the late Imperial period, approximately 1899 - 1917. The 56 mark corresponds to the old Russian zolotnik gold standard, approximately 14K, suggesting the clasp assembly may be a different gold purity than the chain. Total weight is appr. 41.11g. See photos for measurements and condition details.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 45 Glass Insulator
Pressed Glass, Clear, Vintage
A classic piece of American industrial history, this Hemingray No. 45 glass insulator was a standard component for telegraph and telephone lines during the 20th century. These insulators are sought after by collectors for their sculptural form and historical significance in the expansion of communication infrastructure. The No. 45 model features a robust double-petticoat design intended for high-performance electrical isolation.
Double petticoat construction for electrical insulation integrity
Clear glass with a subtle light aqua tint characteristic of period glass production
Embossed "HEMINGRAY - 45" marking prominently on the lower base skirt
Approximately 3.75 inch base diameter and 4 inch total height
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with no major chips or structural cracks. Inner and outer petticoats are intact. Original gloss is well-preserved with minor surface scratches consistent with age and utility service. Threaded core is clean and undamaged.

description:
Bendos Action Figure Lot - 7 Pieces
Kid Galaxy, early 2000s Era
This collection features seven vintage Bendos action figures in their original retail packaging. Known for their "Action Figures with a Twist" tagline, Bendos gained popularity in the late 1990s and early 2000s for their flexible, wire-framed bodies that allowed for infinite posing. This lot represents a diverse cross-section of the line, including sports, classic monsters, and unique character themes, making it an excellent addition for collectors of early millennial toys.
Figures Included:
Hockey Goalie - Blue and yellow uniform with goalie mask and stick, in rectangular box
Sports Referee - Black and white striped jersey with oversized yellow whistle, in rectangular box
Frankenstein Monster - Green-skinned figure with classic flat-top hair and chain accessory, in tube packaging
Caveman - Figure wearing a brown faux-fur style outfit, in tube packaging
Skydiver/Pilot - Yellow and purple suit with goggles, in tube packaging
Medical X-Ray Figure - Character with a skeleton/medical chart overlay, in tube packaging
Bumblebee - Character in yellow and black striped outfit, housed in a unique clear display sphere
Condition:
All figures remain factory sealed in their original packaging. The rectangular boxes show light shelf wear including minor corner softening and slight creasing to the cardboard. The clear plastic tubes and sphere are intact with no major cracks, though some light surface scuffing from storage is present. The internal figures appear pristine with vibrant paint and no visible degradation of the flexible material.

description:
Lot of 3 Art Prints Ming Dynasty Dragon Pipe Bowl and Decorative Patterns
This lot includes three art prints featuring historical and cultural designs. The first print depicts a detailed dragon motif from the Ming Dynasty, sourced from the Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, representing Chinese Ming Dynasty embroidery or textile art. The second print shows a stone pipe bowl carved as a human head, attributed to an anonymous artist and part of the National Museums of Scotland collection, photographed against a blue background. The third print is a black-and-white sheet with various intricate decorative patterns arranged in a grid, likely architectural or textile motifs. All prints are on glossy paper and are in good condition with minor creasing at the edges.

description:
Unbranded
Silver-Tone Metal Smoking Pipe
Traditional Asian Style, Vintage
This ornate smoking pipe features intricate silver-tone wirework and filigree decoration throughout the bowl and stem. The design incorporates traditional Asian motifs, including butterfly-like forms and floral appliques, characteristic of Miao or Hmong metalwork traditions. The elongated, curved stem is segmented by decorative bands and applied filigree, leading to a small, structured bowl area with scrolled wire details and a hanging decorative element.
Silver-tone metal construction with hand-applied filigree and wirework decoration
Traditional Asian design featuring butterfly and floral motifs characteristic of regional metalwork
Elongated curved stem with segmented decorative bands and ring-turned finials
Dimensions: 8.5" H x 3" W x 1" L
Condition:
Good vintage condition with significant natural patina and surface oxidation throughout, giving the metal a yellowish-green hue. No structural breaks or missing filigree elements are apparent. The mouthpiece and bowl opening show expected darkening from age and handling. The metal surfaces remain intact with no evidence of repair or structural damage.

description:
Sheaffer
Ballpoint Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set - Pepsi Advertising Edition
1980s Era, Black Matte Finish with Gold-Tone Trim
This vintage Sheaffer writing set represents a classic piece of 1980s corporate advertising history, featuring the iconic Pepsi "Choice of a New Generation" branding. The set consists of a ballpoint pen and a mechanical pencil, both finished in a professional matte black with elegant gold-tone hardware. As a collaborative piece, it combines Sheaffer's mid-century reputation for reliable writing instruments with the bold marketing aesthetic of one of the world's most recognizable beverage brands.
Matte black barrel construction with contrasting gold-tone clips and decorative bands
Custom Pepsi globe logo emblems mounted on the pocket clips
"PEPSI. THE CHOICE OF A NEW GENERATION." printed in gold-tone script on the pen barrel
Each instrument measures 5" in length and includes the original Sheaffer presentation box
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The matte black finish is well-preserved with only minor surface handling marks. The gold-tone trim remains bright, and the Pepsi logo inserts are intact with vibrant color. The mechanical components of both the pen and pencil are functional. No testing has been performed on the ink supply or lead capacity. The original box is included and shows light storage wear.

description: Vintage Town & Country tobacco smoking pipe made from aged imported briar wood. The pipe features a carved bowl in the shape of a boot or shoe with a black stem. It comes in its original box labeled 'Town & Country Aged Imported Briar' and includes a protective fabric liner. The pipe is in used condition with minor wear and a small chip on the toe of the boot. Suitable for pipe collectors or vintage tobacciana enthusiasts.7x3x2”

Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites

description:
Natural Formation
Amethyst and Quartz Crystal Geode Lot
Natural Mineral Specimens
Approx. 5.5" x 4" and 4" x 2.5"
Unsigned
This lot features two distinct geological specimens, showcasing the natural beauty of crystalline formations. The first is a classic hollow quartz geode with a textured dark matrix opening to reveal a cavity of sparkling white crystals. The second is an amethyst cluster specimen featuring light purple crystalline structures atop a layered agate and rock base. Together, these pieces provide a compelling study of mineral growth and make for excellent decorative display pieces or additions to a rock and mineral collection.
Total combined weight of 3.1 lbs as confirmed by digital scale measurement
One specimen features a distinct amethyst cluster with lavender-hued points and visible agate banding
Exterior bases include minor inventory markings in red and purple ink from previous cataloging
Largest specimen measures approximately 5.5 inches in length based on visual scale
Condition:
Very good natural condition. The crystals remain sharp and intact with no significant damage to the points or facets. The exterior rocky matrices are stable and structurally sound. Note the presence of red and purple ink markings on the base and side of the specimens.

description:
Petrified Wood and Agate Specimen Lot
Mineral Specimen Lot - 2 Pieces
Polished and Natural, Brown and Tan, Vintage
This mineral collector's lot features two distinct geological specimens showcasing the beauty of silicified minerals. The first is a rectangular block of polished banded stone, possibly jasper or agatized petrified wood, featuring rhythmic wavy bands of sienna, tan, and cream with a translucent agate corner. The second is a natural rough specimen of petrified wood showing dark internal wood-grain patterns and a characteristic stone-hard fossilized texture.
Polished block displays intricate wavy banding and a translucent agate section at one end
Rough specimen exhibits dark carbon-rich fossilized wood grain and bark-like outer texture
Heavy stone-hard composition consistent with silica-replaced fossilized material
Polished block measures approximately 7 inches in length; total lot weight 2 pounds
Condition:
The polished block shows minor surface scratches and a small chip along one edge consistent with vintage display. The rough specimen remains in its natural state with jagged edges and exposed fossilized grain. No significant structural cracks observed. Finish on the block remains glossy despite light wear.

title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
